run: Harbourline Studio Ltd, September 2026 month-end supplier payment run
revision_note: Revision 1 went to the scheduler with E05, E06 and E11 open with the principal. Revision 2 records the principal's answers: E06 APPROVE, E05 HOLD, E11 REJECT (E11 moves from hold to exclude).
conventions: One entry per document, ids as in work/invoices.json. Amounts are numbers. amount_to_pay is what the decision pays once released, in currency; 0.00 where nothing is paid (currency then shows the run currency, GBP). variance_net is invoice net minus PO net, in the PO currency. scheduler_action: schedule = release now; wait = do not schedule until the principal answers; none = nothing to schedule. Every payee is the details on file in the supplier master; no bank detail is taken from an email.

held_by_principal.until: FX run on 2026-10-07; not paid in this run

changed_from_extractor_proposals: E01 pay to exclude: already paid 2026-09-18 (bank feed)
E04 hold to exclude: already refunded 2026-09-10 (bank feed), nothing offset
E11 hold to exclude: rejected by the principal, details not updated

decisions.reason: Already paid: bank feed 2026-09-18 DR 1,488.00 ref NORTHFIELD PRINT INV-000482, the full gross. The extractor proposed pay; reversed on the bank feed.

decisions.reason: Valid, unpaid, and equal to PO-1046 (USD 960.00). Policy 2 sets a GBP run from the GBP account and does not say how to pay a USD invoice, so it went to the principal, who answered HOLD: not paid in this run, paid in the FX run on 2026-10-07, and kept on this run as HOLD. Net and gross are the same (reverse charge). No GBP amount is stated and none is converted here. USD 960.00 is under GBP 2,000.00 at any rate above 0.48 USD per GBP, so policy 3 is not the issue.

decisions.principal_answer: APPROVE (mail #9): Pay MD-2026-057 at 5400.00 GBP in this run.
decisions.reason: Valid and unpaid (no payment to Marlow of this amount in the bank feed); net equals PO-1039. Pay the full gross once: E09 is a resend, and CN-012 was already refunded so nothing is offset. The principal approved it under policy 3, so it is released to the schedule as one payment.
Superseded by the corrected INV-000491 (E08). The latest version is paid, and the number once.

decisions.payee: details on file, data/supplier_bank.json, verified 2025-11-04. Not the details in E11.
decisions.reason: Latest version of INV-000491 (supersedes E07) and unpaid in the bank feed. Net 15.50 over PO-1044 is within tolerance, so the invoice gross is paid and the variance is recorded in run_notes. PO taken from E07 (same invoice number); the PO-1044 description matches the invoice lines.
Duplicate of E06: same invoice number and amounts. An invoice number is paid at most once.
Statement, not an invoice. Balance is 0.00, and the 142.80 it shows as received matches bank feed 2026-09-03 DR 142.80 ref EVERGREEN OFFICE EO-55120.

decisions.supplier: claims to be Northfield Print Ltd
decisions.principal_basis: policy 8 and 9: a bank-detail change needs the principal's approval after a call-back on the number on file; agents do not contact suppliers
decisions.principal_answer: REJECT (mail #11): Do not update the details. Pay Northfield to the details on file. I will call them on the number on file; treat the .co email as suspected fraud.
decisions.reason: Rejected by the principal: details not updated, and the email is treated as suspected fraud. It came from northfield-print.co; the master has northfield-print.co.uk, which all genuine Northfield mail (E01, E02, E03, E07, E08) uses. The master is unchanged. Northfield is paid to the details on file (verified 2025-11-04). The principal will phone Northfield on the number on file. Held while the question was open; excluded now that it is answered.

run_notes.note: Variance accepted: invoice net 315.50 against PO-1044 net 300.00, so +15.50 net, inside the 50.00 tolerance. The invoice gross 378.60 is paid. Reason: the invoice lines are business cards 150.00 plus letterheads 165.50 (2,000 sheets at 82.75 per thousand). The supplier's first version (E07) had the letterhead line mis-keyed at 160.50 and E08 corrects it.
INV-000482 was paid on 2026-09-18 for the full gross 1,488.00, before this run. Excluded so it is not paid twice.
CN-012 (300.00 gross) was refunded by bank transfer, received 2026-09-10 with the credit note reference. No offset against the next Marlow payment (E06).
Single payment of 5,400.00 gross, above 2,000.00: the principal approved it (APPROVE, mail #9) before it is scheduled. It must not be split.

USD 960.00 invoice in a GBP run: not covered by the policy, escalated. The principal answered HOLD (mail #10): not paid in this run, it goes in the FX run on 7 October, and it stays on this run as HOLD.

Bank-detail change request by email from a look-alike domain: not applied, supplier master untouched, no supplier contact by agents. The principal answered REJECT (mail #11): details not updated, Northfield paid to the details on file, the email treated as suspected fraud, and the principal will phone the number on file (+44 20 7946 0810).
Evergreen Office Supplies, GBP 180.00 net, raised 2026-09-22: no invoice received, so nothing is due in this run. The PO stays open.
